name: third battle
skip_condition_text:
This battle can be skipped by obtaining a Pokémon with Cut from a trade, and then leaving Cerulean City by cutting the tree blocking the south exit.
If this battle is skipped, it is possible to break the gameplay sequence by having this battle at any point later in the game (even after other battles against Blue).
